chapter_title: Foundations of CBI and Design Tensions
title: Classroom Context Variables
description: CAT 531 textbook section connecting classroom context variables to Design Tension Studio map naming a classroom value conflict and negotiated decision, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Perform a graded, variable-by-variable comparison of a study's or vendor pilot's reported context against your own classroom to decide whether a borrowed result transfers, is suspended, or must be locally piloted.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to make a classroom technology decision more defensible.
